description.value: OPA! of Greece is a Canadian Greek quick-service chain that has been grilling souvlaki skewers, pita wraps, and gyros since 1998. The Chilliwack outlet is located inside Cottonwood Mall, offering a sheltered indoor stop for touring cyclists needing a substantial calorie refuel. The menu spans chicken, lamb, beef, shrimp, and falafel proteins alongside salads and sides.
